messages:
lee-sales: Heads up - NovaMed procurement sent back the MSA with three redlines and asked that the order form include a mandatory PO number field before we execute. They also want EU data residency language and a statement about KMS.
mari-legal: Summary pls? I can review but need specifics: which SLA changes, what KMS warranty, and do they want audit access windows expanded?
dave-ps: Procurement requested: (1) PO required on Order Form, (2) invoice generated on receipt of PO, not countersignature, (3) net30, (4) SLA uptime increased to 99.99% with per-incident credits. They also want explicit "customer-managed keys" paragraph.
lee-sales: Net30 is fine. For invoices on PO receipt, finance usually resists. Nora, can ops accept invoice on PO receipt?
nora-ops: Ops: we can attach PO# to billing metadata for procurement, but our revenue recognition requires executed agreement. We cannot create an invoice that recognizes revenue before countersignature. We can issue a pro forma invoice for procurement if they need it.
accounts-payable: accounts-payable: pro forma invoice is acceptable for our customers but we need a signed order form to trigger actual billing. We'll accept pro forma with PO# as long as final invoice follows within 30 days of signature.
mari-legal: On SLA and credits: we should push back on 99.99% and the penalty language. We can offer 99.95% for Dedicated/Private and 99.9% for Hosted, with a capped service credit schedule. Also request to add maximum aggregate credits per year.
dave-ps: Customer insists 99.99% for clinical workloads. They asked for an escalation clause to execs if incidents exceed X per quarter.
mari-legal: Propose compromise: include a higher target for Dedicated in EU regions if they commit to a 12-month dedicated reservation; otherwise standard SLA applies. Add an exec escalation channel but no unlimited credits.
lee-sales: About KMS: NovaMed requires HSM-backed keys and explicit KMS attestation. Do we have that on private/dedicated?
infra-bot: infra-bot: Current supported: Dedicated offers BYOK with AWS CloudHSM option; Private on-prem supports customer HSMs. Hosted does not offer HSM-backed BYOK today.
nora-ops: We can offer Dedicated BYOK + HSM immediately with a small integration lead time (2-4 weeks) and a one-time setup fee. For Hosted, roadmap is 3-4 months.
mari-legal: For contract language: add a BYOK/HSM clause and a sentence about timing: "If Hosted plan is selected, Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide HSM support within 120 days; Customer may elect Dedicated BYOK as immediate alternative."
dave-ps: Good. Also security asked for SOC2 and iso27001. We have both attestation links; they want an approved pen-test report too and a copy of our data processing addendum with EU SCCs.
lee-sales: I'll attach SOC2/ISO links and propose an NDA for the redacted pentest. Marie, can you attach the DPA with SCCs?
mari-legal: I'll attach our standard DPA with SCCs. For pen test redaction we need a mutual NDA. I'll draft a short NDA and a tracked redline MSA with the BYOK/HSM roadmap and SLA compromise.
nora-ops: DocuSign routing: NovaMed wants route: Legal -> Procurement -> AP -> Exec. If PO present, skip Exec and route to AP then procurement sign-off. We can implement conditional routing with an "Is PO Attached" checkbox.
lee-sales: I'll edit the order form template to include PO field and checkbox and a "pro forma invoice requested" toggle. Dave, include language that pro forma does not equal revenue recognition.
dave-ps: On POC: they want a 45-day EU-hosted POC with data isolation and no training usage. We should add SOW: 45-day EU POC, no model training clause, two-eng onboarding, success criteria, and support hours. Nora, can we provision EU hosted POC quickly?
nora-ops: EU hosted tenancy for POC OK, lead time ~10 business days for provisioning and network setup. If they need Dedicated or on-prem, add 2-3 week onboarding.
mari-legal: Add POC data clause: "Data used for evaluation only; Redwood will not use POC data to improve models without express written consent." Also include IP carve-outs.
lee-sales: Timeline request: NovaMed wants answers and updated MSA by COB tomorrow to stay on their procurement cycle. Marie, feasible?
mari-legal: I'll aim to send a redline with tracked changes by 5pm PT tomorrow. I'll include the DPA, BYOK language, SLA compromise, and NDA for pen test. If they push for invoice-on-PO as binding, we should escalate to finance.
accounts-payable: accounts-payable: finance confirms pro forma + PO is acceptable for procurement process. Final invoice upon countersignature per our revenue rules.
lee-sales: Perfect — I'll reply to NovaMed with expected timeline and mark DocuSign routing plan. Thanks all :pray:
